# Vinayak Bhadani

> Demand planning operator in Dubai who runs independent validation of AI and
> statistical forecasting systems. Tests whether a forecast actually beats its
> baseline out-of-sample, and publishes the method including when the answer is no.
> Currently Demand Planning Executive at Emirates Pride Perfumes.

## The question I work on
Does an AI demand forecast actually beat a seasonal naive baseline?

Vendor accuracy figures are usually produced in-sample, on data the model has
already seen, and are rarely scored against a baseline at all. A model can post a
strong in-sample number and still lose to a simple seasonal naive forecast on data
it has not seen. Walk-forward validation, where the model forecasts only from what
it could have known at each point in time, is what separates the two.

## Engagements
- AI Forecast Audit: independent walk-forward validation of a current or proposed
  forecasting system against naive and seasonal naive baselines, reported as
  forecast value-add by category and horizon. Method and code handed over. 2-3 weeks.
- Validation retainer: independent scoring each planning cycle through vendor
  selection and go-live, holding the vendor to the accuracy number they promised.
- Planning system build: Python forecasting, ERP and Shopify ETL, Power BI and web
  planning dashboards, deployed on live data.

No software licence to sell, no implementation to win.

## Why the validation work is credible
- [AlphaOS](https://vinayakbhadani.com/alphaos/): agentic multi-market trading
  platform. Four research agents on Supabase Edge Functions, AI signal pipeline,
  client-side backtesting engine, portfolio backtester. Notable for publishing its
  own negative result: walk-forward testing showed the strategies do NOT beat
  buy-and-hold out-of-sample (in-sample +0.27 Sharpe, out-of-sample -0.10,
  replicated on crypto at +0.09 -> -0.21). Drawdown reduction of roughly half did
  hold across every variant and both asset classes, so that is what was reported
  as real.
- Operator record at ANDS Dubai, planning 100,000+ units per month across
  China-MENA-GCC: 30-point forecast accuracy gain at category-month level, 30%
  lower air freight cost, 25% relative on-time delivery improvement.
